scope: Saranac Lake High School classes of 1960-2000 (first batch). Classes before 1960 are a later batch.
rules: Every name comes from a public source with a URL. Newspaper names are OCR transcriptions of the Adirondack Daily Enterprise via NYS Historic Newspapers and may contain OCR spelling errors; check the linked page. Nothing here was invented or guessed.

1966.note: A full graduate list is printed on these pages, but the OCR text interleaves newspaper columns too badly to transcribe safely. Needs a human read of the page image.

1974.note: The June 21, 1974 front page refers to a "special insert on SLCHS graduates" that is not in the digitized issue.

1990.note: Only part of the 1990 photo section (06-21, pp. 6-7) has readable OCR.

1998.note: Pages 53-56 of the June 19, 1998 graduation section; earlier pages of the section were not found.

2000.note: OCR text is missing for two of the four section pages (06-23, pp. 55 and 57).
